prompt: A zone file SOA reads: "`example.net. IN SOA dns.pangaea.edu. fred.example.com. (...)`". Which of the following is true of this entry?
choices: The primary name server for example.net is `fred.example.com`.
You should send an email to `fred@example.com` about any DNS related issues with the example.net domain.
The serial number must be incremented by `dns.pangaea.edu`.
The example.net zone has no responsible person defined.
explanation: In the SOA record the second field is the responsible person's email with the first dot replaced by @, so `fred.example.com.` means `fred@example.com`.
